description: This file defines a Kotlin interface 'AttachmentRecyclerListener' used for handling user interactions (clicks and long clicks) on attachment items within a recycler view in an Android app.

classes.name: AttachmentRecyclerListener
classes.description: An interface that declares callback methods for item click and long click events in an attachment recycler view.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Callback function invoked when an attachment item is clicked, providing the item position and its view binding.

methods.name: onLongClick
methods.description: Callback function invoked when an attachment item is long-pressed, providing the item position, its view binding, and returning a Boolean to indicate if the long click was consumed.
